info.name: SCRUM-81 Property contact requests
info.description: Apply property-service V25 (V24 is reserved for lender applications), and notification-service V3 (normally applied by Flyway at startup). Start updated notification-service before enabling CONTACT_REQUEST_PUBLISHER_ENABLED=true in property-service. Use the same RabbitMQ exchange/queue and CONTACT_REQUEST_ROUTING_KEY in both services. RabbitMQ publisher confirms and mandatory routing are required (already in application.yml). Alerts monitoring can stay disabled. Without the publisher enabled, request/CRM/outbox commit and delivery stays PENDING. SENT means broker-confirmed, not inbox storage or email delivery. Email follows existing opt-in and verified recipient preferences. No SES call is made by the property endpoint. Each outbox row retries with stable eventId; after bounded attempts FAILED remains visible. Never replay by making a new event ID. Use two registered accounts: requesterToken and professionalToken (a REALTOR persona, set through the existing profile endpoint); outsiderToken is a third nonparticipant. Directory returns only ID/display name, not private contact details or evidence of professional credential verification. In the real UI the user must select the professional and explicitly consent to sharing contact details and message about this property. These examples set consent=true only to demonstrate that already-confirmed action. Set a known internal propertyId, select professionalUserId from the directory, and generate a new idempotencyKey for a distinct enquiry. Same requester/key/normalized body replays without creating another CRM lead or notification. Phone-only new enquiries do not infer an existing client's identity. Historical request property and lead IDs remain if those source rows are removed. Delivery preferences support NEW_MATCH and CONTACT_REQUEST independently. PUT /api/notifications/preferences is full replacement: include CONTACT_REQUEST to enable contact notifications; [] disables both types. Defaults enable both types in-app with email off. The optional preferences folder demonstrates in-app-only contact delivery and intentionally changes those settings.

request.description: Choose a REALTOR account ID and set professionalUserId. Empty content means no such registered account exists.
201 for a new idempotency key. Saves consent, professional-owned client/lead/activity and delivery event atomically.

  "propertyId": "{{propertyId}}",
  "professionalUserId": "{{professionalUserId}}",
  "contactName": "Postman requester",
  "contactEmail": "requester@example.com",
  "contactPhone": null,
  "message": "I would like to arrange a viewing.",
  "consent": true,
  "consentVersion": "property-contact-v1"
}
